text: :Turn your back on these tiny terrors at your own risk. Imps are small, cackling, mischievous demons. Creatures of felfire and trickery considered lowly among demons, they do not pose a large threat alone and are often underestimated due to their singular lack of toughness. However, when in a group they can quickly replace their fallen and overwhelm their opponents, and their real threat is in how difficult it is to kill every single one of them. Imps emerge from the stomachs of imp mothers. Despite their lack of physical strength, imps possess powers and a cleverness that serve warlocks well, and the simplest of the summoning spells a would-be warlock can learn is that of the imp. Imbued Vials are containers that are created from both hot glass and magic. They are used by the most powerful potions. Most if not all potions available in the expansion require Imbued Vials.

The imperial hall of Capital City was a place in times past where the most significant treaties in all of Lordaeron had been agreed to and signed. With its rich history and ancient by stately decor, the hall cast an aura of tremendous significance upon any discussion taking place there. An elaborately decorated ivory table stands in the center of the room. Terenas Menethil's grandfather had received it as a gift from his northern vassals after his successful negotiations with the elves of Quel'Thalas over the borders there. From the windows in the hall you can see the city. Terenas enjoyed this view, because from it he could see the health of his people. It is here that King Terenas II of Lo
An immortal is a being who will not die of old age and is generally resistant to sickness and injury. Immortality does not confer an immunity to injury nor death by unnatural means.
Immolation Aura is a Demonology warlock ability. It is only available during Metamorphosis (warlock ability).

The Imperial Exchange is a room in of the Shrine of Seven Stars. On the upper level of the left side in the middle, the exchange can be accessed via the Path of Serenity and the Emperor's Step in the back or from the Chamber of Reflection in the front. This room contains a portal to Stormwind City.

The Imperial Mercantile is a section on the upper floor of the Horde-faction city of Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. It houses a portal to Orgrimmar. It connects to Hall of Secrets to the north and The Keggary to the south.

Imprisoned Pterrordax are pterrordax being subdued by Ridge Skycallers around the Crackling Ridge in Vol'dun. They are continuously stunned by the "Skycaller's Subjugation" spell, but they are freed if the corresponding Ridge Skycaller is killed. The freed pterrordax will subsequently fly up into the air, pick up another nearby sethrak off the ground and drop them to their death, before flying away and despawning.

__NOTOC__ Impending Catastrophe is the warlock class ability of the Venthyr Covenant. It's available to all warlocks who join the Venthyr. This ability is also temporarily available during the Revendreth portion of the Shadowlands campaign; it's given by the quest The Authority of Revendreth and lasts until you finish the Revendreth storyline.
Imposter is an anima power obtained from anima caches left behind after defeating Karthazel in Torghast, Tower of the Damned. The power grants a Orb of Deception (Shadowlands).
Imperfect Panacea is an anima power that did not make it to live servers. It replaced Ethereal Key during the PTR, and was in turn replaced by Regenerative Fungus.

Improved Rend increases the bleed damage your Rend ability by up to 20%. It is a passive Arms talent, and automatically affects the Rend ability when it is used. It has no prerequisites and is thereby a cheap talent in itself. Rend is rage efficient DPS boost as it is, and this talent improves, indeed, on that. It allows Rend to be efficient even in battles that doesn't last the duration of the Rend. Because both the base damage and the additional damage is multiplied, the advantage of slow, hard-hitting weapons are even greater. However, it still isn't usable in Berserker Stance, and it is still only possible for a warrior to have one Rend on a target active. Because of this a warrior may o
Improved Demoralizing Shout improves the Demoralizing Shout ability, increasing the amount that the enemy's Attack Power is reduced by.
Improved Power Word: Fortitude increases the stamina buff provided by Power Word: Fortitude and Prayer of Fortitude; also increases caster's stamina.

Improved Tree of Life is a talent in the Druid Restoration tree, requiring you to spend 44 points in Restoration to max it. The talent Tree of Life is a prerequisite. Improved Tree of Life form increases your armor contribution from items by up to 200% and increases your healing spell power by up to 15% of your spirit, but only while in Tree of Life Form. This spell power increase applies only to healing spells, not damage, although this matters little as you cannot cast any damaging spells aside from Thorns and Nature's Grasp while in Tree of Life form.
Incendrites drop from the following fire elementals in Stonetalon Mountains: *Burning Ravager *Rogue Flame Spirit *Burning Destroyer

Incanter's Absorption is a Mage talent in the Arcane tree. When you absorb damage with Mana Shield (Classic) or Mage Ward, this talent turns a percentage of that damage into spell power, placing a buff on you. Also when Mana Shield is destroyed enemies within 6 yards are knocked back 12 yards.
__NOTOC__ Indestructible Plate Girdle is created with Blacksmithing (450); taught by Plans: Indestructible Plate Girdle.

Indentured Protectors are human ghosts found at the Obelisk of the Stars in Uldum. They can only be seen using Sapphire Spectacles, which you get while doing the quest By the Light of the Stars. Once the player loots Suspended Starlight, any protectors nearby will become hostile and attack.

The Incursion is the first Alliance base, though unintended, in the Krasarang Wilds. The night elves came across information predating Queen Azshara's rule about the Pools of Youth, with coordinates pointing to the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. After Lorekeeper Vaeldrin gained the reluctant permission of High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind for an expedition, they set up a portal from Darnassus to the Vale. However, the Vale was the capital and seat of power of the ancient mogu empire. In order to prevent a direct assault on the Vale the mogu magisters of Emperor Dojan II set up arcanic oubliettes, or magic traps, inside what were named the Dungeons of Dojani in Krasarang Wilds, for any foolish en

Indellium is a sacred species of hop plant only found in a hidden valley in the Stonetalon Mountains, where it is watched over by Orremin, a keeper of the grove. The plant has many uses—the keepers of the grove valued it for its medicinal properties, but as with many other hop plants, the flowers can also be used in brewing beer. It was once abundant before the Great Sundering, but after the rending of the world only a single field in Stonetalon remained. Years ago, Orremin was awoken from the Emerald Dream by his dryad sisters and found that the field had been ravaged by goblins, all but destroying the indellium plants. The brewmaster Chen Stormstout—who had heard of a hidden valley in Ston

Inferno is a warlock AoE spell that summons an Infernal and requires an Infernal Stone. Once the Infernal is summoned, it will automatically be under the effects of Enslave Demon for one minute, after which it will die. Inferno has a cooldown period of ten minutes. The Infernal has a permanent Immolation aura that breaks CC. In Alterac Valley players tend to over estimate the Infernal's strength and can be used as a rather effective distraction target. Inferno has a 100% spell power coefficient.

__NOTOC__ Inethven is a blood elf mage trainer located in Sunfury Spire in Silvermoon City. He directs mages to Ureda for class quests. He was present in the Court of the Sun during the closing of the remembrance ceremony.
Infernal Attacker can be found outside Wildhammer Stronghold and Shadowmoon Village in Shadowmoon Valley.

Indu'le Village was a tuskarr village found northwest of Moa'ki Harbor in the Dragonblight. The village along with the villages were destroyed by arcane energies that poured out from the ley line. The Kalu'ak that were not immediately killed, becoming ghosts, by the chaotic magic coming from Lake Indu'le still suffered and become deranged.

Infinite Destroyer is an infinite drakonid that will appear during Mystery of the Infinite in the Bronze Dragonshrine to prevent you from learning the true identity of the leader of the infinite dragonflight.

The Inevitable is a tar-colored elven destroyer captained by Captain Malus, leader of the Hidden. Its crew consists mostly of humans and it transports the rest of the Hidden. It also has its own longboat. Having gained knowledge about Malus's old enemy and his ship - Captain Greydon Thorne and the Wavestrider - from Jonas Cobb, the Inevitable chased Greydon's ship across the Veiled Sea some time after the Cataclysm. Inevitables crew attacked and destroyed it but two crew members - Aramar Thorne and Makasa Flintwill - escaped. The Inevitable then landed near Feralas's coast. Once Malus became the new leader of the Gordunni clan, he ordered Ssarbik to contact his sister on the Inevitable in or
Infinite Power is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Infused Shadowsong Amethyst is a socketed gem crafted by Jewelcrafting. It requires a minimum skill of 375 and a Simple Grinder. ; Materials required: :1x Shadowsong Amethyst The recipe for this item is taught by * Design: Infused Shadowsong Amethyst (Scale of the Sands, requires reputation) and * Design: Infused Shadowsong Amethyst#Shattered Sun Offensive (Shattered Sun Offensive, requires reputation)

Injured Carnies are carnies found in Darkmoon Island that have been injured in the setting up, taking down, and transporting of all its attractions. Players with First Aid are tasked by Chronos with assisting them. A group of them can be found near Chronos, while another group can be found at around these co-ordinates: .

__NOTOC__ Initiate Chuang is a pandaren located at the Peak of Serenity in Kun-Lai Summit. He is an assistant of Master Hight and shows the monk adventurers around the temple. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, the demons invaded the Peak of Serenity. Chuang quickly ran into the Shrine of the Ox to warn the other monks, but an Infernal Destroyer chased the initiate, charged, grabbed him, crashing into the other door. after the infernal was destroyed, Master Hight questioned him, before passing out. Iron-Body Ponshu then picked him up, reviving him with ale.
Injured Warbraves are Highmountain tauren located in Thunder Totem of Highmountain.
Injured Protectors are Highmountain tauren located in Highmountain during Legion Assaults.

Initiate Okan is a centaur located next to Windsage Tohr at the Ohn'ir pools in Maruukai in the Ohn'ahran Plains. He is training at hitting Tohr's moving orb of wind magic with bolts of his own magic.

Injured Mages are located at Vakthros Range in the Azure Span. Having been wounded by the Summoned Destroyer, Luddy Quicksnap guards them as he battles the fire elemental. When it has been defeated, Luddy will teleport them to safety.
Insect Swarm is a DoT with a 12 second duration that deals nature damage. Along with Moonfire, this ability accounts for a large amount of overall damage during fights when used by a Balance Druid.
Innkeeper Norman is a Forsaken innkeeper located in the Inn of the Trade Quarter in the Undercity. He was present during the Battle for Lordaeron and could be evacuated out of the Undercity.

Innkeeper Faralia is a night elf innkeeper located at Stonetalon Peak in the Stonetalon Mountains. She has been missing since the Cataclysm, presumably having been killed by the faceless ones that destroyed the Stonetalon Peak camp.

Innkeeper Janene is an innkeeper located in Theramore Isle's inn in Dustwallow Marsh. Janene insisted on staying behind in Theramore instead of evacuating with other civilians, and so was likely killed when the city was destroyed by a mana bomb.
__NOTOC__ Innkeeper Darg Bloodclaw is an orc innkeeper located in Shadowmoon Village in Shadowmoon Valley.
Insane Strength Potion can be crafted with Alchemy (320); taught by Recipe: Insane Strength Potion.

Inner Demons are summoned in the Leotheras the Blind encounter; up to five players are targeted by Leotheras' ability, and must kill their own Inner Demon before Leotheras returns to his humanoid form. The Inner Demons of other players appear as black silhouettes, and cannot be damaged except by the player they spawned for. The monsters take additional damage form Holy, Nature, and Arcane abilities.

Insane in the Membrane is a Feat of Strength that rewards the title . This feat requires you to become honored with the Bloodsail Buccaneers and exalted with the Steamwheedle Cartel (Booty Bay, Everlook, Gadgetzan, Ratchet), Ravenholdt, and Darkmoon Faire. It does not require that all of these reputation levels be reached at the same time. Raising reputation with these factions is typically very difficult, time-consuming, and costly—hence the title.

Intercepting the Mana Cells is part of the Shattered Sun Offensive storyline. This quest is made available to players once they have recovered the Sun's Reach Sanctum on the Isle of Quel'Danas. Once players have activated the Sunwell portal in Shattrath City, Maintaining the Sunwell Portal replaces this quest.
Internal Medicine is a passive Mistweaver Monk ability, available at level 20. It improves Detox, making it remove all harmful Poison, Bleed and Magical effects.
Instability is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Instructor Allandria is a night elven member of the Druids of the Talon found at the Sylvan Falls in Highmountain, instructing Fledgling Druids on the art of using Flight Form correctly.
Invasion Point: Cataclysm is a staging ground for the Burning Legion. It is located in the northwestern part of Shadowmoon Valley, up in the mountains.
__NOTOC__ Iorioa is a draenei portal trainer of the Sha'tar located on the Terrace of Light in Shattrath City. Next to her are the portals to Orgrimmar and Stormwind City.
Iridi was a draenei priestess who hailed from the shattered continent of Outland. She became an instrumental player in the battle of Grim Batol and the death of Dargonax.

The Iron Horde (later referred to by some of its members as the Fel Horde and Gul'dan's Horde) was formed initially as an union of the uncorrupted orcish clans of a parallel and created by Garrosh Hellscream and his father, , who was convinced by his unknown son's (who was never born in the alternate universe) knowledge of advanced machinery and the existence of a different world in order to attain orcish supremacy in the universe. The clans were united under a single leader, Grommash Hellscream of the . Bent on the conquest of Draenor and Azeroth, the Iron Horde is an enemy to be feared. It is the main antagonist faction of the Warlords of Draenor expansion and a successor to the True Horde

Irmaat was a renowned tol'vir bronzesmith who lived in the city of Ahmtul thousands of years ago. He was known all throughout Uldum for his excellent work in creating magical weapons that represent the air spirits that live there, but his pride proved to be his undoing.
The Iron Star Roller was an Iron Star mount. It was never made available.

__NOTOC__ Irewing is an elusive yet highly ravenous roc, cursed by harpy magic, circling above its nest in the northern part of Pinerock Basin in Highmountain. As the final test of Addie Fizzlebog's skills as a hunter, Hemet Nesingwary sends Addie and the adventurer to send up a flare and bring down Irewing so Hemet's hunting party can kill it. After killing the beast, Hemet says that the encounter will make a fine chapter in his next novel, and Addie, who is also Nesingwary's ghostwriter, says that the party should return to Nesingwary's Retreat while the kill is still fresh in her mind. Back at camp, Hemet admits that he's not sure if he and his companions could've killed the roc without t
__NOTOC__ Ionized Minnow are fish in the waters of Mechagon Island. They are a scourge of these waters. They strip the ocean floors of any food, making it difficult for other species to survive.

Iridikron the Stonescaled is one of the four Primal Incarnates. Along with his brethren, he rejected the gift of the titans and turned to the elements instead, becoming an incarnation of earth itself. The eldest of the four Incarnates, his mastery of the earth allows him and his siblings to move about the world undetected. While his younger brother Fyrakk is just as strong as he is, Iridikron's greatest strength is his intelligence. His all-consuming hatred led him to embrace war against the Aspects the most among his siblings, being the last- and most difficult to contain of the Incarnates. Having made deals with both the Void and the Infinite dragonflight, Iridikron ultimately plans to unm
Irideus' Power Core drops from the Watcher Irideus in the Halls of Infusion. The Maiden of Inspiration in Valdrakken wants it to continue powering up the Engine of Ingenuity with it.

Ironforge Mountaineers are dwarves that protect the vast region of Dun Morogh. They patrol Kharanos and Ironforge Airfield and provide directions to various locations in Kharanos, Thelsamar, and Ironforge. Some of them are mounted on rams. They are also present at an unnamed farm in the Wetlands side of the Ironforge Mountain.

The discipline and training that dwarven fighters receive shows through in the elite Ironforge city garrison. Several of these units, staff the city's defenses under the command of dwarven captains and sergeants. Their commander, or rather subcommander is Sergeant Dimurov Grimear. During war, the garrison can muster enough troops to defend every entrance and major throughway in Ironforge. Flanking intruding enemies with a barrage of flintlock rounds and bombs, and then closing on the ragged remains of their foes with battleaxes ready, the dwarves have proven their tactics brutally efficient.

The hotel district of Ironforge is a district containing lodging for the visitors to the city. It is apparently in the seventh level of Ironforge. It can be reached by going down to the eighth depth of Ironforge, then taking a right, another right, a left, through three doors and finally going up a level to reach the district. The hotel district apparently doesn't directly connect to the sixth level or the sections of the seventh level containing the market, requiring a bit of a detour through the city to the deeper eighth depth before returning to the section of the seventh, where the hotels are located.
banner.]] Ironforge Mountain is the largest of the various mountains constituting Khaz Modan. It is located in central Khaz Modan, north of Dun Morogh and southwest of the Wetlands.
Ironmarch Scouts are orcs found at the Shattered Beachhead and Shattered Landing in the Blasted Lands.

__NOTOC__ Irongrove Retreat is a small grove located just beyond the Feathermane Hunting Grounds in Suramar. The night elf refugees came here fleeing from Val'sharah when Ysera began her attack on the temple, many from villages that ended up getting destroyed from the Nightmare. Many elves set out from these villages, but the Nightmare would follow them everywhere they went taking several lives before they finally crossed into Suramar, the Nightmare stopped following after that. In hopes of settling in their new location, they began befriending the creatures of the land to receive their blessings in order to create a new moonwell.

The Ironhorn tribe of Highmountain tauren are renowned blacksmiths that reside atop the tallest peak of Highmountain in Ironhorn Enclave. They perpetuate the metalworking tradition of their ancestor Rethu Ironhorn. They use double the metal of any normal blacksmith to craft their wares. They craft legplates out of leystone. They share their recipes only with trusted individuals. Members of the Ironhorn tribe participated in the War of the Ancients, fighting in Azshara.

The Isle of Tribulations is an island in Lake Elrendar, north-east of Suncrown Village inhabited by crypt fiends. Young Blood Knights often came here during the first trial of their abilities, having to light up a brazier inside the cave on the isle.
The Isle of Spears is an island in west Howling Fjord. The tuskarr villages, Kamagua and Iskaal, are found here. You can get to this island by taking the Ancient Lift.

The Isle of Quel'Danas (also known as the Sunwell Isle or simply Quel'Danas) is a zone north of the Eastern Kingdoms added in patch 2.4, and is one of three areas that make up Quel'Thalas. It is the first outdoor zone added to the game via a patch, and includes many daily quests as well as the last raid and dungeon content released prior to World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King. The island's highlights include the Sunwell Plateau, the site of the sacred Sunwell from which Kil'jaeden is being summoned; Magisters' Terrace, the place Kael'thas Sunstrider made his final stand; and Sun's Reach, a town reclaimed by a combination of Aldor and Scryers forces known as the Shattered Sun Offensive.

Isle of Conquest All-Star is a player vs. player achievement earned for assaulting a base, defending a base, destroying a vehicle and killing a player in a single Isle of Conquest battle. This is not a cumulative achievement. All components must be completed within one instance.

.]] Irontree Clearing, located in Felwood, comprises the northern section of Irontree Woods that includes Irontree Cavern. It is a Horde-friendly area full of Irontree Shredders and a strip mining camp. The Clearing stretches from the area around the Cavern all the way across the main Felwood road to a small Horde camp and quest hub, complete with a flight master. The goblins of this clearing have begun attacking the worgen and night elves located in nearby Talonbranch Glade who have attempted to stop their lumber operations. The Clearing's lower reaches are later attacked and destroyed by the Worgen following the increased hostility.

Isle of Conquest Emissaries were human Isle of Conquest recruiters located at various spots throughout the largest Alliance cities - Stormwind City, Exodar, Darnassus, and Ironforge, as well as the neutral cities of Dalaran and Shattrath City during the monthly Call to Arms: Isle of Conquest.

The Isle of Shadows is located south of the Forgotten Shore of in the Evanescent Sea. Darkmaster Go'vid of the commands a small army of undead makrura and skeletal orcs from this island. There is also a Waterlogged Chest on the southwest side of the island. It contains the Darktide Pincer and roughly . During Hallow's End, this area is assaulted by the Bonefleet.
__NOTOC__ Isoraen Nightstar is a night elf quest giver located at the Temple of Elune in Val'sharah. Based on his appearance, he is a Druid of the Moon.

The Irontide Raiders (or simply the Irontide, and apparently under the business moniker of Sweete Enterprises of Freehold) are a ruthless pirate band based out of Freehold in Tiragarde Sound. The original members of the Irontide Raiders were leftover from a crew once captained by Flynn Fairwind and his first mate Harlan Sweete. The two had a falling out after a messy job and Flynn lost all taste for freebooting, so just disappeared one day. Meanwhile Harlan took the nastiest of the crew and formed the Irontide Raiders. Harlan then went around Freehold forcing smaller crews to pledge loyalty.
Island Flotsam is a reward from Island Expeditions. It is also bought from Captain Zen'taga in Zuldazar for .

The Isle of Fangs is a small island off the southern coast of Zuldazar in the Bay of Kings. It's the southernmost point of Zandalar. Like Tusk Isle just to the north, the Isle of Fangs is used as a port and outpost by the Zandalari Empire, with part of the Golden Fleet being moored here. The island also has its own watch tower which can be used to send signals across the bay.

An unnamed worgen pack can be fought during Island Expeditions. It seems to be matriarchal, as they count several female druids among their ranks. The males appear to almost all be feral, while the women seem to have some semblance of control. The moon seems to be important to them, as they mention it before dying.
Island Slayer is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing a series of PvP Island Expeditions achievements.
Island Conqueror is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing a series of Mythic Island Expeditions.

__NOTOC__ Isaac's Test Creature was an ogre located in Ironband's Excavation Site in Loch Modan for the first week of patch 10.0.7. A nearby Golden Eagle could be seen flying in circles around the ogre, occasionally flying close and hovering just above him.

__NOTOC__ Ithelis is a blood elf paladin trainer located in the Hall of Blood in Silvermoon City. Following the start of the Burning Legion's third invasion, he joined the Silver Hand and is located in the Sanctum of Light. Following the split of the Order during the Fourth War, he is no longer a member of the Silver Hand. He was present in the Court of the Sun during the closing of the remembrance ceremony. After the death of Vorath, Ithelis was among the gathered paladins outside the Hall of Blood in Farstriders' Square to congratulate the sin'dorei hero for their victory in Deatholme.
Jadaar is a draenei at the Argent Tournament Grounds. He argues constantly with Asric. The two of them are rumored to have been spotted enjoying the sights and sounds of Darkmoon Island occasionally.
:Were you looking for Jacob Alerius? Jacob is a cougar pet of Angelas Moonbreeze located at Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

__NOTOC__ Ithurian Whitespire is a Highborne night elf arcane reforger located in the Cordell's Enchanting shop found in the Canal District (Mage Quarter section) of Stormwind City. He is part of the Whitespire family and is standing near Lucan and Jessara Cordell. Recently, however, the business of reforging in the city has been taken over by the ethereals of The Three Winds establishment, near Cathedral Square. He is apparently related to Aladrel Whitespire and Erdunor Whitespire, two other Highborne magi who have settled in Darnassus and Ironforge, respectively.

Jab is a monk ability, available at level 1. The Monk passive ability Fighting Style causes Jab to change its icon and tooltip depending on what type of weapon is equipped, altering the Monks fighting style appearance. Damage and resource cost remain the same.
It's the Stones! is an achievement earned from destroying 5 Draenic Darkstones in Socrethar's Rise, . The player must be on the quest Assault on Socrethar's Rise in order to destroy them.

It All Makes Sense Now is one of the three pre-Legion Feats of Strength achievements. To earn it, speak to Doomsayers in Stormwind City or Orgrimmar and collect all of their pamphlets. Doomsayers can be spoken to once every 15 minutes (all Doomsayers share a timer), but there is a workaround involving death abuse. Note that the hidden debuff does not tick down while logged out, only while logged in! The achievement is also not account-wide - one character must come up with all 12 pamphlets!

__NOTOC__ Iyneath is a night elf of the Sentinels with long silver hair and one eye. He is taller than his sister, Llaran, and has a striped moonsaber called Cinderfoot. The two siblings took down a black drake who held Makasa Flintwill in its claws in the Charred Vale in the Stonetalon Mountains. The Sentinels took Makasa and her friends to a camp to recuperate and, alongside Aiyell, offered them to take them to their destination, Thal'darah Overlook. Later, when he was grooming his saber cat, the Sentinel was approached by Aramar Thorne who asked him about possible Alliance places where his uncle, Silverlaine Thorne, could be. The Jagged Reef is the name for the northern coast of Azshara. It consists of stretches of sandy beach, broken up by jets of stone and small inlets of the ocean. Traveling along the shore here is hazardous due to the treacherous rocks and shallows that lie beneath the ocean surface. Murlocs, hydras, and makrura inhabit the region, swimming in the shallows or plodding across the beach looking for food.
Jambiya is sold by: * in Thunder Bluff * in Darnassus * in Ironforge * in Ironforge * in Darnassus * in Undercity * in Ironforge * in Orgrimmar * in Undercity

The Jade Vaults is a section on the upper floor of the Horde-faction city of Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. It is the bank and guild bank area. It connects to the Chamber of Wisdom to the south and Hall of Tranquility to the north.

Jag Stormantler is a Highmountain tauren found on a wooden balcony halfway down the cliffside southwest of Thunder Totem in Highmountain. He claims to be "the headbutt champ" and challenges players who approach him to a headbutting contest.

Jasperlode Mine, like Fargodeep Mine, was one of the key mining sites in Elwynn Forest, providing Stormwind City with valuable raw materials needed in the wars. Lately, however, the mine has been overrun by kobolds, and with all the challenges that its army has to face, Stormwind does not have the manpower to drive the vermin out. Unfortunately for the kobolds of Elwynn Forest, the deepest recesses of this mine have been overrun by a colony of Mine Spiders who apparently see the hapless kobolds as a tasty snack. Although these spiders do not venture far from their nest, adventurers should beware as their queen, Mother Fang, does not approve of any uninvited guests. Marshal Dughan had a night

__NOTOC__ Jandria is a night elf priest trainer located in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. During the Burning of Teldrassil, she was seen putting out fire. Ultimately, she refused to leave the Temple of the Moon. After her death, her soul ended up in the Maw, as a result of the Arbiter's incapacitation. While being imprisoned within the Tremaculum, she was rescued by mortals aligned with the Night Fae Covenant, at the urging of Ysera. Following her liberation, she came to reside in the Heart of the Forest within Ardenweald.

Janeiro's Point is a small island just outside Booty Bay, upon which a giant statue of an unknown goblin with outstretched arms was built as a beacon to all travelers, welcoming ships to Booty Bay. The sea giant Mok'rash the Cleaver has chosen the island as his abode.
Jar of Ashes can be acquired while doing archaeology on Highmountain Tauren digsites in the Broken Isles. This was originally an Artifact Power item; now, it's simply vendor trash.

__NOTOC__ Jamie Harriott is a Gilnean woman that can be found talking with Rachel DeSimone, Carrie Eileen Steen and Jenn Stravaganza inside the Howling Oak, in the night elven city of Darnassus. During the Burning of Teldrassil, she was seemingly evacuated with the civilians to Stormwind City.

Jaxi Sparkshine is a gnome, and Windle Sparkshine's wife. She has an exceptional talent for baked goods, which she often supplies for Aimee to sell. Her red velvet cupcakes are extremely popular. Her daughter, Kinndy, was the apprentice of Jaina Proudmoore. Although they missed their daughter, Jaina often allowed Kinndy to visit Jaxi and Windle in Dalaran, as it was only a simple teleport spell away. When the Horde began threatening Theramore, Jaina stopped by the home of the Sparkshines and assured them she would do everything in her power to keep Kinndy safe. However, Kinndy was one of those who died in the Attack on Theramore Isle. Jaina, the sole survivor, met with the Sparkshines at A H

A kingdom is a state or country ruled by a king or a queen. In Warcraft, however, the term is sometimes used in a more broader sense to serve as a synonym for "state" or "country" - the magocracy of Dalaran, the state of Kul Tiras and the city-state of Theramore have all been referred to as kingdoms despite not being ruled by royalty. The Korune clan is a clan or a tribe of mogu that has been in hiding for centuries, but finally revealed themselves once more after hearing of the rebirth of the Thunder King. They performed many dark experiments for their king during his reign. They appear to have the ability to control the sha energies and use their dark powers for their own. They created the Divine Bell, as well as a device capable of storing sha.

Kormrok is a boss in the in Tanaan Jungle. The fight revolves around Kormrok empowering a different set of abilities based on which pool he leaps into: Green for earth/fel, Orange for fire, and purple for water/shadow.
Krumn is a tauren guild master located on the lower rise in the tauren city of Thunder Bluff. During the feast for the Highmountain tauren, he was trapped by the Void.

Krixx is a goblin that roams around in the orcish city of Orgrimmar. He was added to help players know where the zeppelins currently are, without having to go outside to the tower. He's also the brother of Kraxx, who does the same thing in Undercity.

The Krazzworks is a goblin island off the shore of the Twilight Highlands. It is led by Captain Krazz. Its unique architecture is the result of a device similar to the Town-In-A-Box being deployed in the wrong place. The Krazzworks is currently under siege by the Wildhammer dwarves, who are attempting to repel the invading goblins. With the misdeployment and the attacks, the town is barely operational. Only two zeppelins are in service, flying between there and Dragonmaw Port. The inn and a small area below the zeppelin towers are the only areas that are locked down by the Horde, and most of the town's NPCs can be found crammed inside or nearby.
Kwee Q. Peddlefeet was a winged, flying goblin quest giver that could be found hanging around participating capital city leaders during the Love is in the Air seasonal event.

Kur'kul was once a shaman of the powerful Blackrock clan on Draenor prior to the corruption of the orcish race. When the elements abandonded the shaman, Kil'jaeden offered to teach Gul'dan the path of the warlock so that he may teach the shaman. The shaman of the Blackrock clan were chosen to be the first trained in the dark arts. Kur'kul and the others learned quickly and soon demonstrated their powers to the other chieftains and shaman, to most of their approvals. Kur'kul was later sent by Blackhand to the clans, aging all children between the ages of six and twelve to adulthood, in order to increase the Old Horde's numbers. Kun-Lai Summit (pronounced "KUHN-lai") is a zone in northern Pandaria, surrounded by the Vale of Eternal Blossoms to the south, the Townlong Steppes to the west, and the Jade Forest to the east. It is a vast area with majestic mountains, autumnal plains, and a lush coastal area. High atop the frigid northern peaks looms the Temple of the White Tiger, an ancient training ground protected by an elite force of martial priests, along with the spirit of the White Tiger itself, Xuen. Deeper into the mountains is the hideout of the Shado-pan clan: a mysterious order charged with protecting Pandaria from the dark things buried beneath its surface. After the death of Zhi the Harmonious, the mogu seized over the vale. Kuru helped to defend the Shrine of Seven Stars. Kuru appears to be fond of puns.
Kurd Butterhoof is a Highmountain tauren vendor found in a hut south of the upper level of Thunder Totem in Highmountain, where she sells "homemade" dairy products.

Kura Stonehoof is the wife of Warbrave Oro, found at Oro's Overlook in Highmountain where she lives with their two sons — Mycah and Oro Junior. During Assaults on Highmountain, the Stonehoof family retreat into their hut, with Kura and Mycah defending the entrance while Oro Junior stays behind them.

Kuglaroth is a pit lord conjured by the Feltotem tribe in the Lair of the Devout on Highmountain's western coast. Marius Felbane considers it a creature of great evil and beyond his and Tehd Shoemaker's ability to defeat on their own, and so he asks adventurers to help them defeat it.

The Kul Tirans (or Kul Tiran humans) are one of the playable Alliance allied races in World of Warcraft, introduced in Battle for Azeroth. A specific breed of human that hail from the island nation of Kul Tiras, they are brawnier than their mainland cousins, but share a history spanning the wars with the Horde. Kul Tirans start out in their capital city of Boralus, before reporting to their faction's embassy (much like all other allied races). They tend to ride horses like humans do, albeit a sturdier variety, and speak the same Common language.

The Kul Tiran civil war was an armed conflict which occurred on the island chain of Kul Tiras between the ruling dynasty of House Proudmoore and a number of dissident factions, around the time of the Fourth War. Specifically, the houses of Ashvane and Stormsong separately sought to overthrow Proudmoore power and take the nation for their own ends. Mostly localized to the regions of Tiragarde Sound and Stormsong Valley, the fighting would eventually threaten to topple the Proudmoore Admiralty, particularly during the climactic Siege of Boralus. The Kul Tiran fleet, also known as the Proudmoore fleet, is the principal naval force of the Admiralty of Kul Tiras. It specifically refers to the main body of the modern-day Kul Tiran navy, which forms much of the nation's offensive and defensive power. The fleet is a highly formidable force and is central to the legendary reputation of Kul Tiras as a maritime power. It is also the latest in a long line of Kul Tiran fleets, such as the doomed Third Fleet of the Second War. While the Stormsongs build every ship of the fleet, the tidesages bless every last Kul Tiran vessel, which is what really sets them apart from the ships visiting Kul Tiras. The Kul Tiras Navy was a Kul Tiran army that controlled the island-chain and the sea near Theramore Isle under the command of Daelin Proudmoore right after the invasion of Durotar. It was attacked by the Horde in order to take down Daelin in Jaina's city. Notably, they used Wave and Storm Towers.
__NOTOC__ Kualiang Thunderfist is a pandaren warrior trainer located in the Training Hall in Stormwind City. He is described by the city guards as one of the most skilled fighters.

Lady Sarevess is a naga found in the Pool of Ask'ar of Blackfathom Deeps. Sarevess is a very twisted spellcaster who dabbles in the realm of magic. When she failed to provide sufficient magical protections, though, Domina sacrificed her to the Old Gods, and her body can still be found on its altar. Her successor has retained some of the spellcaster's items.

Lady Cozwynn is a Forsaken who resides at Crushblow. She states that Lady Sylvanas Windrunner herself sent her to the Highlands in order to serve as a Horde liason, and to "mend broken fences" between the Dark Lady and Warchief Garrosh Hellscream. She appears briefly in the fight against Skullcrusher the Mountain, alongside Zaela and Garona healing the two.

Lady Quinby was a powerful lich of the House of Rituals who wielded unequaled sorcery. Though her phylactery was destroyed, she defended the Shadowlands until her final moments. An epitaph in her honor is located in the Iron Trench.
Lady Moonberry's Best Friend is a level 60 Venthyr Covenant quest that becomes available after reaching Best Friend status with Lady Moonberry.

The serene Lake Everstill is a large azure lake located in the center of Redridge Mountains. The crystal-clear waters of the lake provide a spectacular setting for the sleepy settlement of Lakeshire. It is drained by its eastern river which flows near the dark Stonewatch Keep. Lake Everstill was once known for its fishing but recently has become overrun by tribes of murlocs. Adventurers hunting murlocs in the lake should make sure to keep an eye open for the elite Lake Thresher that patrols the deeps. The lake is crossed by Everstill Bridge. The scholar Teronis was last seen near the lake, and it boded ill of his fate that he never returned. The murlocs eventually left the lake, which became dank and gloomy. Lake Indu'le is located in the middle of Indu'le Village. It was from this lake that magic leaked out, due to the blue dragons' actions west of the lake, that killed most of The Kalu'ak inhabitants and made the rest deranged. Corrupted Ragers now swim in the lake and a Ley Line Focus arch can be found on the bottom of the lake with dead Focus Wizards, Dragonblight Mage Hunters, and Mage-Commander Evenstar floating around.

Lakeside Landing is a small landing area for gyrocopters located on the northern portion of River's Heart in central Sholazar Basin. Pilot Vic, a Cold Weather Flying trainer, and a flight path is found here.

Lady Vesthra is one of the two naga witches masterminding the assault on the Southern Rocketway Terminus. She is located at the Ravencrest Monument in Azshara where she is being empowered by a power stone.

The Lair of Tortos is the section within the Forgotten Depths found just below the Stormbridge. Heroes are sent crashing down into the lair by the Thunder King when he destroys the bridge while the heroes are attempting to cross. After killing Tortos, his body shatters allowing the adventurers to continue towards the rest of the cavern.
